(()=>{const g=__game; for(let i=0;i<150;i++) g.furnace.output.push(20101); const maxcz=Math.max(...g.field.blocks.map(b=>b.cz)); const front=g.field.blocks.filter(b=>b.alive && b.cz>=maxcz-1).slice(0,24); const stub={pos:g.player.pos.clone()}; for(const b of front){stub.pos.set(b.cx*2.5,0,b.cz*2.5+3); g.mining.damage(b,1e6,stub);} g.player.pos.copy(g.shopB.zone.center).add(g.player.pos.clone().set(-4,0,4)); g.timeScale=8; window.__wt0=g.time; return {tray:g.furnace.output.count, broke:front.length, drops:g.drops.list.length};})()

(()=>{const g=__game; return {gameSec:+(g.time-window.__wt0).toFixed(0), tray:g.furnace.output.count, fq:g.furnace.queue.length, drops:g.drops.list.length, workers:g.workers.map(w=>({n:w.profile.name, role:w.profile.role, st:w.state, sta:w.stamina, cnt:w.stack.count, ingots:w.stack.items.filter(i=>i>=20000&&i<30000).length, at:[+w.pos.x.toFixed(1),+w.pos.z.toFixed(1)]})), trayPos:[g.furnace.trayPos.x,g.furnace.trayPos.z], pad:[g.furnace.zone.center.x,g.furnace.zone.center.z]};})()

(()=>{const g=__game; g.timeScale=4; const v=g.vehicles.find(v=>v.key==='hydraulicBreaker'); g.mount(v); const maxcz=Math.max(...g.field.blocks.filter(b=>b.alive).map(b=>b.cz)); const b=g.field.blocks.find(b=>b.alive && b.cz===maxcz); v.pos.set(b.cx*2.5,0,b.cz*2.5+1.25+v.radius+0.2); v.facing=Math.PI; window.__vb={f0:v.fuel, t0:g.time, r0:g.field.remaining}; return {fuel:v.fuel, power:v.power, interval:v.interval, reach:v.reach};})()

(()=>{const g=__game; const v=g.driving; const dt=g.time-window.__vb.t0; return {gameSec:+dt.toFixed(1), fuel:+v.fuel.toFixed(2), burnPerSec:+((window.__vb.f0-v.fuel)/dt).toFixed(3), broken:window.__vb.r0-g.field.remaining, oilRack:g.oil.rack.count, oilLocked:g.oil.locked};})()

(()=>{const g=__game; g.dismount(); const a=g.vehicles.find(v=>v.key==='allTerrainVehicle'); g.mount(a); a.pos.copy(g.oil.zone.center); window.__atv0=g.time; return {driving:g.driving?.key, rack:g.oil.rack.count, atvStack:a.stack.count, atvCap:a.stack.capacity};})()
(()=>{const g=__game; const a=g.driving; return {driving:a?.key, gameSec:+(g.time-window.__atv0).toFixed(1), atvStack:a.stack.count, rack:g.oil.rack.count};})()
